method: Derive exact caller-owned whitespace and control-character framing from every proven host-facing ASCII record recovered in FinalNativeClosure0017. Count CR, LF, CRLF, tab, leading/trailing whitespace, and embedded NUL properties without assigning unsupported Worldgroup terminal-translation behavior.
interpretation_limits: The observed bytes prove the MajorMUD caller-side text contract only.
Worldgroup may translate, buffer, coalesce, or reorder output after receiving these bytes.
Absence of CR/LF in a literal does not prove the host will not append framing.
Runtime-built and indirect strings remain outside this static evidence set.
